summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (L26) proposing an assumption-kill experiment to test whether melatonin's lifespan/healthspan benefits are solely MT1/MT2 receptor-dependent. The document frames a pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel design where melatonin vs. vehicle is tested under luzindole or Mtnr1a/Mtnr1b LOF (loss-of-function) conditions that abolish melatonin-class longevity attribution, with the primary prediction that residual early healthspan/metabolic improvement under the block arm retains ≥50% of the MT-intact melatonin vs. vehicle effect. The experiment has NOT been run; the document is a research discussion/proposal at TRL 1–2.

content_blocks.title: Document Overview and Claim
content_blocks.content: Mol Labs public report L26 (PUBLIC_REPORT_ONLY). The central claim: On a pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel (Pierpaoli/Anisimov-class) with melatonin vs vehicle under luzindole or Mtnr1a/Mtnr1b (MT1/MT2) LOF that abolishes melatonin-class longevity attribution, same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (melatonin vs vehicle under abolish) retains ≥50% of the melatonin vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on MT-intact concurrent controls. This is framed as an 'assumption-kill' / mt-receptor-insufficiency test. Residual-positive melatonin lifespan or healthspan H2H under luzindole/Mtnr1a/Mtnr1b abolish is explicitly stated as UNKNOWN. Execution status: NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale and Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Melatonin longevity/healthspan benefits are often attributed to MT1/MT2 receptor necessity. Key literature grounding: (1) Pierpaoli PNAS 1994 (PMID 8290600) — melatonin night administration and pineal grafting prolong survival/postpone aging in mice; no luzindole or Mtnr1a/b residual lifespan H2H; pineal-grafting ≠ MT-receptor residual H2H. (2) Anisimov J Gerontol 2001 (PMID 11445596) — melatonin increases life span in female CBA mice (also increases spontaneous tumor incidence); no MT-abolish residual arm. (3) Jin Mol Cell Biol 2003 (PMID 12529409) — Mel1b/MT2 targeted disruption as genetic LOF tool (circadian/SCN); no aging/lifespan/healthspan endpoints. (4) Dubocovich Eur J Pharmacol 1990 (PMID 2168835) — luzindole (N-0774) as melatonin-receptor antagonist with antidepressant-like activity; NOT a melatonin × luzindole longevity residual arm. (5) Zhang/Heliyon 2024 (PMID 39347399) — melatonin ameliorates aging cardiac dysfunction but cannot improve cardiac function without MT1/2; cardiac necessity AGAINST residual for that endpoint; ≠ organismal residual-positive H2H. The document concludes that a matched residual-positive melatonin lifespan/healthspan H2H under luzindole/Mtnr1a/Mtnr1b abolish remains UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content: Prior art status: PARTIAL. Phenotype founding (Pierpaoli, Anisimov) and LOF tools (Jin MT2 KO, Dubocovich luzindole) are found in literature. Organismal residual-positive melatonin lifespan/healthspan H2H under luzindole or Mtnr1a/Mtnr1b abolish is ABSENT from public prior art. Zhang 2024 cardiac MT1/2 necessity is noted as outside public prior_art (≤4 references). Liu Mel1a/MT1 KO (PMID 9247266) — optional MT1 tool, no aging endpoints, OUT of public prior_art. Chern luzindole∩lifespan (PMID 22330064) — ischemic-stroke OFF-PANEL, excluded as longevity residual anchor. Soft-complete empty ≠ novelty / ≠ failure.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Experimental Design and Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Proposed assay: Pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel (Pierpaoli/Anisimov-class). Design: melatonin vs vehicle × luzindole (or Mtnr1a/Mtnr1b LOF) with abolished melatonin-class-control-benefit definition. Prefer cell/tissue/block-QC before new animal longevity. Primary endpoint: early healthspan/metabolic referee within the refute window (6 weeks). Optional full-lifespan co-readout only as secondary. Threshold: ≥50% retention of MT-intact melatonin vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement under abolish lock. Refute if: same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (melatonin vs vehicle under abolish) is <50% of the melatonin vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on MT-intact concurrent controls — when abolish-fail, melatonin-alone-null, underpowered-strata, or assay-mismatch artifacts are ruled out. Kill cost tier: 2. Time to refute: 6 weeks. IP class: mt-receptor-insufficiency. Vault hold: no.

content_blocks.title: Differentiation from Other Series (L15–L25)
content_blocks.content: Explicit differentiation from prior series: L15 (DunedinPACE/Oh organ-age) ≠ L26; L16 (tissue SA-β-gal/p16 vs blood under D+Q) ≠ L26; L17 (intermittent-rapa FKBP-high tissue mTORC2) ≠ L26; L18 (17α-E2 × caloric-match residual) ≠ L26; L19 (acarbose × glycemic-match residual) ≠ L26; L20 (SPD residual under ATG5/7/autophagy-insufficiency; MT ≠ bulk ATG) ≠ L26; L21 (UA residual under PINK1/Parkin/mitophagy-insufficiency; MT ≠ mitophagy) ≠ L26; L22 (metformin residual under AMPK LOF; MT ≠ AMPK primary; melatonin ≠ metformin) ≠ L26; L23 (lithium residual under GSK3 LOF; MT ≠ GSK3) ≠ L26; L24 (canagliflozin residual under SGLT2 LOF; MT ≠ SGLT2) ≠ L26; L25 (resveratrol residual under SIRT1 LOF/EX527; Melatonin/MT ≠ SIRT1; melatonin ≠ resveratrol; do not collapse via PMID 25975679) ≠ L26. NOT NAD-after-senolysis (SERIES_FROZEN). L1–L25 ≠ proof of L26.

content_blocks.title: Execution and IP Status
content_blocks.content: Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN. IP class: mt-receptor-insufficiency. Vault hold: no. Kill cost tier: 2. Time to refute: 6 weeks. Status labels: NEGATIVE. Novelty tag: assumption-kill. Polarity: negative. Risk class: research-discussion. Related prior: Pierpaoli 1994 melatonin/pineal grafting survival + Anisimov 2001 female CBA life span + Jin 2003 Mel1b/MT2 KO tool (no aging endpoints) + Dubocovich 1990 luzindole antagonist tool (≠ longevity residual); Zhang 2024 cardiac MT1/2 necessity OUT of public prior_art. Dual-publish status: PENDING.

key_findings: Experiment has NOT been run (execution_status=NOT_RUN); this is a research discussion/proposal at TRL 1.

Central claim: melatonin lifespan/healthspan benefits may not be solely MT1/MT2 receptor-dependent; residual-positive melatonin healthspan H2H under luzindole or Mtnr1a/Mtnr1b LOF abolish is explicitly UNKNOWN.
Pierpaoli 1994 (PMID 8290600) establishes melatonin/pineal grafting survival phenotype but lacks luzindole or Mtnr1a/b residual lifespan H2H; pineal-grafting ≠ MT-receptor residual H2H.
Anisimov 2001 (PMID 11445596) establishes melatonin life span increase in female CBA mice (with tumor incidence caveat) but lacks MT-abolish residual arm.
Jin 2003 (PMID 12529409) provides Mel1b/MT2 KO as a genetic LOF tool for circadian/SCN studies; aging/lifespan/healthspan endpoints are absent.
Dubocovich 1990 (PMID 2168835) establishes luzindole as a melatonin-receptor antagonist tool; NOT a melatonin × luzindole longevity residual arm.
Zhang 2024 (PMID 39347399) shows melatonin cannot improve aging cardiac function without MT1/2 — cardiac necessity AGAINST residual for that endpoint, not organismal residual-positive H2H.
Prior art status: PARTIAL — phenotype and LOF tools found; organismal residual-positive melatonin lifespan/healthspan H2H under MT abolish is absent from public prior art.
Proposed primary endpoint: early healthspan/metabolic improvement within 6-week refute window; full lifespan only secondary.

Refutation threshold: block-arm early healthspan/metabolic improvement <50% of MT-intact melatonin vs vehicle improvement (when confounds ruled out) = melatonin reduces to mere MT-receptor-necessary bridge.
Competing inconclusive outcomes pre-registered: abolish-fail, melatonin-alone-null, underpowered strata, assay-mismatch.
Explicit differentiation from L15–L25 series; MT ≠ SIRT1, MT ≠ AMPK, MT ≠ bulk ATG, MT ≠ mitophagy, MT ≠ GSK3, MT ≠ SGLT2; melatonin ≠ resveratrol; NOT NAD-after-senolysis.
